title: Quality of Pain Management at the Ziv Medical Center
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare attitudes and knowledge of the staff of various departments in our Medical Center in regards to pain treatment. With the results of our survey we will then draw up a protocol on pain management.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Staff from the Ziv Medical Center and patients

Exclusion Criteria:

Staff members that do not deal with pain treatment
study_population: The population includes patients in pain.
condition: Focus of the Study Includes Patients in Pain
